title: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Hints at a Major Thor Power Upgrade
excerpt:
Yellow lightning surrounding Thor has sparked Odin Force speculation.
The trailer also raises questions about a possible mission with Steve Rogers.
body_md:
A ComicBook.com analysis of the final Avengers: Doomsday trailer focuses on a striking image of Thor surrounded by yellow lightning. The sequence suggests a significant increase in his abilities, prompting speculation that the Marvel Cinematic Universe could be introducing a version of the Odin Force from the comics.

That interpretation is not confirmed. The article explicitly notes that the trailer does not explain the nature of Thor's apparent new power. Earlier promotional material shows him being repelled by Doctor Doom while using his familiar abilities, making the later lightning sequence especially intriguing.

Chris Hemsworth's Thor is positioned as a central figure in the conflict, which brings together heroes from different corners of Marvel's multiverse against Doctor Doom. The article frames the film as a major convergence point for the Multiverse Saga.

Another intriguing moment involves Thor and Steve Rogers. Their exchange indicates that Steve continues to use Mjolnir, after which the two fly away together. The writer speculates that the scene could set up a search for reinforcements ahead of Avengers: Secret Wars.

The timing of that exchange within the movie is unknown. It could occur near the end of Doomsday, as the analysis suggests, or simply represent the two heroes reconnecting before the main conflict. Neither possibility is established by the trailer alone.

The article lists December 18, 2026 as the film's release date. Until the story is seen in full, the power-up and potential follow-on mission remain interpretations of the footage rather than confirmed plot revelations.
